socfpga_combophy_ll.h

Combo PHY low-level driver interface for the SoCFPGA bare-metal software stack.

This header provides low-level primitives for accessing the Memory-Mapped I/O (MMIO) registers of the Combo PHY controller. These helpers are used to perform direct register-level configuration of the PHY's physical lane settings and status registers.

socfpga_combophy_ll_read
uint32_t socfpga_combophy_ll_read(
uint32_t 
base_address,
uint32_t 
offset
)

Performs a direct 32-bit Memory-Mapped I/O (MMIO) read from an arbitrary register offset within the Combo PHY instance.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The physical MMIO base address of the target Combo PHY instance.

offset
uint32_t

The exact 32-bit aligned register offset to read.

Returns

The raw 32-bit hardware value at the specified address.

socfpga_combophy_ll_write
void socfpga_combophy_ll_write(
uint32_t 
base_address,
uint32_t 
offset,
uint32_t 
value
)

Performs a direct 32-bit Memory-Mapped I/O (MMIO) write to an arbitrary register offset within the Combo PHY instance.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The physical MMIO base address of the target Combo PHY instance.

offset
uint32_t

The exact 32-bit aligned register offset to write.

value
uint32_t

The 32-bit data payload to commit to the register.
